subject: Tripelock: Request for quarterly invoicing + Net-60 (DL-2027-1147)
messages:
From: Grace O'Connor <grace.oconnor@redwood.ai>
To: Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>, Lauren Bishop <lauren.bishop@redwood.ai>, Amit Patel <amit.patel@tripelock.com>
Cc: Tripelock Procurement <procurement@tripelock.com>
Date: Sun, 14 Nov 2027 08:15:00 -0700
Subject: Tripelock: Request for quarterly invoicing + Net-60 (DL-2027-1147)

Team —

Quick context: Tripelock (prospect -> closed-won) is finalizing the SOW (attached) but their treasury requires quarterly invoicing across three legal entities and they requested Net-60 payment terms instead of our standard Net-30. They are asking for Net-60 + quarterly invoice cadence for the first 12 months.

Why this matters: deal ACV $420k ARR, expected rollout Jan 2028. They are ready to sign but procurement says the billing pattern is non-negotiable on their side — it’s a corporate policy. We risk losing the timing if we push standard terms.

What I’m asking for: executive/finance signoff to accept (1) quarterly invoicing across three entities and (2) Net-60 payment terms for year one, with conditions (PO before first invoice and a 1.5% financing fee on outstanding invoices over 45 days). I’m also proposing to apply a one-time onboarding credit of $5,000 instead of a larger discount.

Attachments: Tripelock_SOW_signed.pdf, Tripelock_SLA.pdf.

Please advise — Jonas, Marissa: approve or escalations needed? Amit: any flexibility on PO timing or can you commit to PO before first invoice?

— Grace
Grace O'Connor
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
grace.oconnor@redwood.ai
+1 415-555-0182

From: Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwood.ai>
To: Grace O'Connor <grace.oconnor@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>, Lauren Bishop <lauren.bishop@redwood.ai>
Date: Sun, 14 Nov 2027 11:42:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Tripelock: Request for quarterly invoicing + Net-60 (DL-2027-1147)

Thanks Grace — quick questions before I greenlight:

- Revenue and cashflow impact: what is the expected DSO increase and FX/tax implications with the three-entity consolidation?
- Credit/risk: do we have any credit history or references for Tripelock? If not, we should run a light credit check and consider a security hold or reduced onboarding credit.
- Discount: you propose a $5k onboarding credit. Given the additional collection risk I want to avoid a straight price concession unless we add a financing fee or a short-term escrow.

If legal can add a PO-before-invoice clause plus the 1.5% financing fee and we get a PO before first invoice, I’m tentatively OK to approve Net-60 for year one only. I’ll need margin impact numbers from you (gross margin on the deal with the $5k credit factored in).

Lauren — can you pull credit file / HubSpot payment history for Amit's company? Grace — please send the margin calc (simple line items).

Jonas
Jonas Weber
Head of Revenue Ops, Redwood Inference
jonas.weber@redwood.ai

From: Grace O'Connor <grace.oconnor@redwood.ai>
To: Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>, Lauren Bishop <lauren.bishop@redwood.ai>, Amit Patel <amit.patel@tripelock.com>
Date: Mon, 15 Nov 2027 09:05:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Tripelock: Request for quarterly invoicing + Net-60 (DL-2027-1147)

Thanks Jonas — margin calc attached (payment_plan_proposal.xlsx) and HubSpot deal link: https://app.hubspot.com/contacts/123456/deal/1147.

A few notes from procurement (Amit copied):
- They can issue a master PO that references three legal entities. The PO will be routed internally and will be in place before they process the first invoice (they confirmed this is their usual cadence).
- They cannot move to Net-30 — it’s an enterprise treasury rule tied to a quarterly close cycle.
- They’re fine with a small financing fee to cover working capital; Amit said they will consider 1.0–1.5% if we push that to their AP team.

Proposed guardrails:
- Conditional approval for Net-60 for Year 1 only.
- Quarterly invoicing across the three entities as separate line items but consolidated in our billing system for revenue recognition.
- PO must be received before first invoice is issued.
- Financing fee 1.5% applied to balances >45 days; fee applied to the first year only.
- Onboarding credit $5k, applied to first invoice.

If legal can draft a 1-page addendum (attach addendum_template.docx) with those conditions, we can move forward to signature.

Amit — can procurement confirm PO cadence SLA (we need PO within 7 business days of SOW signature to meet our go-live)?

— Grace

---

From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
To: Grace O'Connor <grace.oconnor@redwood.ai>, Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwood.ai>, Lauren Bishop <lauren.bishop@redwood.ai>, Amit Patel <amit.patel@tripelock.com>
Date: Tue, 16 Nov 2027 17:03:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Tripelock: Request for quarterly invoicing + Net-60 (DL-2027-1147)

Approved with conditions — thank you for the thorough framing. Executive decision: approve the Net-60 + quarterly invoicing for Year 1 only under the guardrails Grace proposed.

Action items (approved):
1) Finance to accept quarterly invoices and record revenue as described, contingent on PO before first invoice.
2) Apply a one-time onboarding credit of $5,000 (applied to the first invoice).
3) Add financing fee of 1.5% on balances over 45 days for the first 12 months.
4) Legal to prepare a 1-page addendum and route through DocuSign; use the HubSpot deal link and attach the addendum.
5) No change to base list price beyond the $5k credit. Any further concessions require VP sales signoff.

Jonas / Finance — please prepare the addendum and the billing instructions. Lauren — pull the credit check and confirm PO cadence within 24 hrs. Amit — please confirm PO timeline so we can schedule the first invoice.

Marissa Cole
SVP, Sales — Redwood Inference
marissa.cole@redwood.ai
